summary: Comprehensive testing of Recent Payees and Sort Code Validation features. Backend: 10/10 tests passed (100%). Frontend: 7/7 tests passed (100%). All features working correctly - Recent Payees auto-fill, sort code validation (empty/incomplete/unrecognized), bank lookup, and end-to-end transfer flow.
critical_code_review_comments: Recent Payees feature implemented perfectly - saves payees on transfer, displays as horizontal scrollable chips
Payee auto-fill works flawlessly - tapping a chip fills name, sort code, and account number
Sort code validation correctly blocks transfers for empty, incomplete, and unrecognized sort codes
Duplicate payee handling works correctly - updates existing payee instead of creating duplicates
GET /api/payees correctly sorts by last_used descending (most recent first)
DELETE /api/payees/{id} works with proper 404 handling for non-existent payees
MongoDB _id correctly excluded from payee responses
Bank lookup integration working - displays bank name with green checkmark for valid sort codes
Error messages are clear and user-friendly with red styling
All testID attributes present for automated testing
seed_data_creation: Test user sorttest@test.com already has 4 payees from previous transfers. Backend tests create additional TEST_ prefixed payees for testing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Recent Payees and Sort Code Validation features tested and working perfectly. No issues found. The app correctly saves payees on transfer, displays them as chips, auto-fills on tap, validates sort codes before transfer, and shows appropriate error messages for invalid sort codes.
